title: Septic Service Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control site assessment, safe access, inspection, pumping, maintenance, transport, and handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete septic service customer completion sign-off for tanks, baffles, pumps, controls, distribution components, and drainfield observations. It connects system records, approved scope, and disposal authority to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified septic-service technician and property owner or authorized contact must reconcile the promised septic service scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.title: Septic Service limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Tank location, access, buried utility, or component identity uncertain
Cover, riser, tank, soil, or surrounding surface appears unstable
Confined-space entry, fall-in, engulfment, toxic gas, or oxygen concern
Ignition source, fire, explosion, electrical, or mechanical exposure
Sewage contact, splash, aerosol, spill, backup, or public exposure
Hose, vacuum, valve, truck, cap, containment, or traffic control defective
Unexpected industrial, hazardous, chemical, or prohibited waste suspected
Pumping may damage an unknown, fragile, or structurally compromised component
Transport manifest, vehicle authorization, facility acceptance, or disposal route unavailable
System failure, surfacing effluent, contamination, or repair need exceeds scope

sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This septic service customer completion sign-off is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when tank access, collapse, confined-space, toxic or flammable atmosphere, sewage exposure, buried utility, pumping, transport, disposal, or system condition is uncertain. A septic, wastewater, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
